n8d35a4c861.headline: Tunisia: BTK, loss-making, robbed by its employees and under thorough tax control, respects neither the Cook ratio nor the risk rate
n8d35a4c861.summary: BTK, the Tunisian branch of French banking group BPCE, reported net banking income issues and is under thorough tax control, failing to meet certain financial ratios.
n8d35a4c861.why: BTK's financial health affects Tunisia's banking sector stability and investor confidence in regional banking institutions.
